stalls.summaryZh: 1960年代開業的老店，北港風羹湯甜而不膩，可加麵、米粉或飯。
stalls.summaryEn: A shop dating to the 1960s; Beigang-style broth that is sweet but not cloying, served with noodles, rice noodles or rice.
